question_and_initial_information: 优化任务，Opaque无初始世界模型。自主固定0.04 mol/0.08 L，起始A0.005 mol、水330 K/1800 s。与Aligned参考配方不同，信息比较包含配方锚定而不仅方向文字。
expectations: 只有v1事前笔记预期温和加热安全且有可测转化，先筛物料再优化；没有中途笔记，K1/K2解释变化动因属回顾性。
tests_and_observations: 73动作全部提交。仅第1批有紧邻终检的HPLC。B0.001 mol/水360 K与四催化剂0.00025 mol比较；再B高载量筛三其他溶剂；乙腈360→390→410→400 K。低载量A转化0.2996但选择性0.0482，B转化0.2129、选择性0.1689。B加量使yield0.0416→0.1081、选择性0.1689→0.3668。甲苯转化最高，乙腈选择性/score最高。390 K score0.10009，400 K0.09458，410 K0.07771，无源重复。
revisions: 终末笔记与K1给有范围的催化剂排序及390–400 K宽窗口，承认高低载量A比较混杂温度、时长和搅拌。用支路竞争解释转化与选择性排序不同，但平行/顺序未唯一识别。
later_use: 推荐第10批，复测score0.10168。Q用B两载量关系外推小体积高浓度：conversion MAE0.01198，risk MAE0.17850。Q假设风险随时间累积、阈值压零score、淬灭稍增风险；没有像Aligned首场一样假设回滚。
unresolved: 正确转化预测不等于掌握唯一机制。风险/淬灭仍错配；K2承认无公开乘法安全gate却给近零score。只有起止两版笔记，不能精确定位解释中途形成时点。K2未再提交Q，不是改善结果。

anchors.quote: I will first screen catalyst/solvent combinations at conservative thermal exposure, then refine the best public safe-score region.
The campaign did not replicate the optimum or independently vary time near 390 K.
A plausible explanation is competition between a background undesired pathway and a catalyst-dependent desired pathway.
The exponents n and m cannot be estimated from only two loadings.
The catalyst-to-reagent ratio and catalyst concentration are much higher than in the source campaign, so I expect nearly complete conversion and better desired-path capture than in batch 11.
This order effect is speculative; a purely parallel, time-integrated kinetic model would make Q07 and Q08 nearly identical.
Predicting near-zero scores above the safety limit was reasonable for the safe objective, but the public scoring contract did not reveal an explicit multiplicative safety gate.
